## {{< fa route >}} How the day runs

One question, your own, runs through the whole day. Each round changes one thing: who reads the files, who decides the steps, who reviews, and where the instructions live. Every round ends with the same check: would I merge this?

There is a break at every full hour, and each break slide carries one question to take with you. The block after the break opens with it.

The schedule with the rounds is on the [overview page](../index.qmd).
